CONSOLIDATION · OCTOBER 31, 2026

One guide.
A clear record.

About Eclipsed Realms remains authoritative. Compatible additions were merged into the player guide; conflicting and unverified claims remain clearly marked reference material.

What was carried forward

All four sites’ readable sections and hidden profile/spell panels, all 49 storyboard beats, the Atlas’s 18 guides, five priorities and 16-performance index, plus 21 visual references. The unpublished Design Atlas was recovered from its local October 11 export, whose documented state ends October 8.

The 74 underlying project-document snapshots remain in the existing local Atlas export. This site preserves the Atlas’s rendered guides and source filenames, rather than copying those raw documents. The archive is self-contained and does not require the old sites. Local source backups are retained.

The game project was not changed. Game tests were not rerun. Website validation is separate from the historical gameplay evidence quoted in the archive.

Conflicts & decisions

Resolved conflict

Solo and co-op

Earlier material. Eclipsed Realms describes the game as single-player. Discover describes online and local co-op.

Merge decision. Keep About: solo, online guests in the host’s world, and up to two local players on the host machine. Do not turn four-player or 2 + 2 targets into confirmed support.

Resolved conflict

Discovery versus fast travel

Earlier material. The original promises unlimited travel to discovered waypoints; Discover also offers travel to previously discovered origins.

Merge decision. Keep About: discovering a region and binding its Cursed Doll are separate. Using a regional Doll to enter training binds that destination to the individual player; the Arena Doll offers bound destinations.

Resolved conflict

How the campaign ending is chosen

Earlier material. The original frames the outcome around faction allegiance and standing. Older moral-route language can imply that karma selects the ending.

Merge decision. Keep About: the decisive ending is an explicit story choice, committed by the host. The Design Atlas places it at the End Church and explicitly excludes the legacy karma-threshold route. Faction relationships remain distinct.

Older sources disagree

Opening location and attic chronology

Earlier material. The original opens among bodies in the ossuary beneath a house; Storyboard and Discover open in the Torture Dungeon. Storyboard places the attic memory late in Act I.

Merge decision. Use the project-backed Design Atlas sequence alongside About: Doll → cage exit → attic memory → village. About does not name the exact opening room, so retain its neutral wording. Preserve the older named locations and late-memory ordering as historical story proposals.

Resolved conflict

Spell rosters, schools and ultimate slots

Earlier material. The original lists Blood Rain, Area Bleed and Blood Meteor and puts Flesh Demon under Dark. Discover uses the newer Blood list, but advertises five spells plus a separate ultimate and omits Void Stasis.

Merge decision. Keep About’s named examples, including Blood Offering, Blood Rush, Blood Rupture and Dark Void Stasis. The Atlas’s bundled Relief Kit identifies rank/slot 5 as the ultimate and Summon Demon as Blood. Retain other old names, slot counts and exact tuning only as historical reference, not a complete current spell roster.

Wording narrowed

Relief access and release

Earlier material. Discover says the Relief must always be wielded and deployed. The original describes a fixed influence size and fixed controller behavior.

Merge decision. Keep About’s carry-or-equip wording and ability-specific requirements. Costs commit on release; an interruption before release spends no cost. Do not generalize every old placement, radius or binding rule to every current ability.

Resolved conflict

Jester eligibility and restoration

Earlier material. Discover limits replays to completed main quests and says they award no XP or loot.

Merge decision. Keep About: eligible completed or failed quests, including side quests, can become performances. Campaign state is restored and gains/losses do not carry back. Some are solo-only; the Atlas supports performer-only restoration in eligible co-op performances.

Needs confirmation

Personality names

Earlier material. Original and Storyboard use Cruel / Cunning / Compassionate. Discover uses Witty / Empathetic / Bold.

Merge decision. About supplies no authoritative three-label set. Use general wording about dialogue and relationships on the main page; preserve both sets here until the project confirms the names.

Needs confirmation

Cathedral, Nun and Witch Priest naming

Earlier material. Original and Storyboard associate the Gothic Cathedral with the Witch/Nun region; Discover also labels the supplied cathedral as Cult territory and uses Witch Priest.

Merge decision. Keep neutral descriptions of the religious regions. Do not merge distinct churches or declare Witch Priest and Nun interchangeable. Gallery captions retain the supplied cathedral-reference label without confirming the final in-game location.

Design targets only

Unvalidated modes and progression promises

Earlier material. Discover lists four online players, 2 + 2 households, dungeon helpers, 1v1–4v4 arenas and New Game+ / New Game++.

Merge decision. Preserve as older design targets in the archive. About confirms solo, online guests, two local players, training and conditional replay. It does not establish those extra configurations or modes as available.

Not revalidated

Numbers, bindings and feature availability

Earlier material. Older pages specify health/damage curves, XP pacing, armor bonuses, starting points, spell tuning, Dark Point penalties, day/night ratios and controller bindings.

Merge decision. Preserve the dated values for reference; do not import them as current promises. The Atlas also records input conflicts, pending physical-controller checks and a guards-proof regression. Historical test passes do not validate today’s game build.

Historical narrative / spoilers

Lore, endings and Chapter II

Earlier material. The older sites add the First Binding, character motives, irreversible events, faction outcomes and a Chapter II frontier.

Merge decision. Merge the shared premise and neutral regional context into About. Preserve all 49 storyboard beats behind a spoiler control. Older detailed outcomes and Chapter II geography remain narrative reference; absence from About is not proof of implementation or a contradiction.

Needs confirmation

Arena enemy names

Earlier material. Original and Storyboard call the six arena enemies Greater Flesh Demons.

Merge decision. Keep About/Atlas’s neutral six-demon ordeal language. The Atlas’s bundled session-f record explicitly declines to infer that the six numbered NPC definitions are the Flesh Demon roster. Retain the older classification as lore terminology.
